questions.text: Как ответить на «Is there a fridge in the kitchen?», если он есть?

options.text: Yes, there is.
Yes, it is.
Yes, there are.

questions.explanation: Fridge — единственное число, ответ: Yes, there is.

options.text: The carpet is under the table.
The carpet is on the table.
The carpet is next to the table.

questions.text: Какие фразы верно описывают мебель в комнате? (выбери все верные варианты)

options.text: There is a bed and a wardrobe in my room.
The chair is next to the sofa.
The lamp is on the table.
There are a shelf.
The clock in on the wall.

questions.explanation: Shelf (одно) требует is, а не are; «in on» — опечатка, нужен только один предлог on.

options.text: on
in
under

questions.explanation: Часы висят на стене, предлог on.

options.text: next to
in

questions.text: Впиши предлог: The cat is ___ the bed.
Впиши слово: она на столе — It's ___ the table.

pairs.left: What furniture is there in your room?
pairs.right: There is a bed, a wardrobe and a shelf.

pairs.left: Is there a mirror in your room?
Is there a fridge in the kitchen?

questions.text: Как перевести «В моей комнате есть кровать и шкаф»?

options.text: There is a bed and a wardrobe in my room.
There are a bed and a wardrobe in my room.
My room there is a bed and a wardrobe.

questions.explanation: Разговорная норма — there is + перечисление, начинающееся с единственного числа (a bed).
